faq.q: Can we bring our own food and drinks?

faq.q: What happens if the weather is bad?

data.body_html:
Combine a private boat charter with a jetski, snorkelling gear, and a paddleboard for the ultimate Marbella family boat day jetski snorkel paddleboard combo. All departures from Puerto Banús, with a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, and snacks included. Prices start at €749 for 2 hours on an Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39, and go up to €4,719 for 4 hours on a Mangusta 80 with a free jetski.

What’s included in the combo

  • Licensed skipper and crew
  • Fuel for the full charter
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, and light snacks
  • Snorkelling masks and fins
  • Paddleboard (inflatable, stored on board)
  • Jetski (included free on Mangusta 80 charters of 4+ hours; available as add-on for other boats)
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21%) – no hidden extras

Choose your boat

Our fleet of 17 boats departs from Puerto Banús. For a small family (up to 5), the Dubhe (8m) or Mariah SX21 (6.4m) are nimble and easy. For up to 9 or 11 guests, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) and Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) offer plenty of deck space. The Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) is ideal for larger groups and includes a jetski free on 4-hour bookings. All boats have shaded areas and a bathroom.

Pricing – clear and up front

All prices include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and IVA.

Itinerary ideas

Your skipper will tailor the route to your family. Popular options include:

  • Marbella coastline – past the Golden Mile, La Concha backdrop, and Cala del Faro for snorkelling.
  • Cabopino – quiet coves and the sand dunes, 20 minutes east of Puerto Banús.
  • Cala Cortés – a rocky cove with clear water, perfect for paddleboarding.
  • Estepona – head west for a longer cruise, with stops for swimming and jetski fun.

What to bring

  • Swimwear and towel
  • Sunscreen (SPF 50+ recommended, April–October)
  • Sunglasses and hat
  • Extra snacks or lunch (cooler and ice provided)
  • Camera or phone (waterproof case handy)
  • Light jacket for evening returns

Why book with us

  • No hidden fees – the price you see is the price you pay
  • All boats depart from Puerto Banús, the heart of Marbella’s marina
  • Experienced, English-speaking skippers
  • Flexible durations from 2 to 8 hours
  • Jetski, snorkel, and paddleboard all in one day
